scope: One completed one-workbook study resumed through the ordinary SheetShrink web configurator and its saved launch receipt
limitations: The saved runner retains its own earlier capture policy and producer identity.
The test verifies reuse of a completed study; it does not prove recovery at every interrupted phase.
This test does not establish relocation of a distributed runtime package.
The resume endpoint was exercised over HTTP; the form itself was browser-checked in the preceding prefill acceptance.
